note: Behaviour archetypes. Data, not code — docs/dnd/03-KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md §7. `weights` are how much this archetype reaches for each affordance (rules/ruleset.py AFFORDANCES); `priors` are the disposition it implies, read backwards to ask how well a given person fits the archetype rather than stamping it on them.

packs.label: Coward
packs.description: Gets out. Talks their way clear if they cannot, gives something up if they cannot do that, and fights only when there is nothing left to try.

packs.label: Zealot
packs.description: Says the thing. Does the thing. Does not leave, does not hide, and is not much interested in what it costs.

packs.label: Merchant
packs.description: Everything is a transaction and most of them are conversations. Would rather buy the problem than fight it.

packs.label: Predator
packs.description: Waits, closes, takes. Violence is not a last resort here, it is the shortest route.

packs.label: Loyalist
packs.description: Stands where they said they would stand, next to whoever they said it to. Will fight for someone else long before they fight for themselves.

packs.label: Opportunist
packs.description: Reads the room for what is loose in it. Rarely starts anything, and is never the one left holding it.
